agentSummary: Adds tools for Mover 2.0 movement components: inspect and author movement modes, queue layered moves, modifiers and instant effects, and verify velocity or mode changes in Play In Editor.
enablesAgentTo: Inspect a Mover component's movement modes, shared settings and backend
Add, configure and remove movement modes with Undo support
Queue layered moves, movement modifiers and instant effects during PIE
Sample velocity and mode over frames to verify a movement change
whenToEnable: Your project uses the experimental Mover plugin (UE 5.5+) for character or vehicle movement.
